item.title: 🎃 Halloween: The Game — New Post
item.dc:creator: @HalloweenTVG
item.description:
Halloween: The Game (@HalloweenTVG)

Patch 1.1.1 is now live. This update introduces a variety of crash fixes for Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and PC.

🟩 Fixed a crash that could occur when using Quick Resume on Xbox Series X|S

🟩 Fixed a shader crash that could occur when using Performance Mode on Xbox Series X

⬛ Fixed crashes caused when using DLSS and FSR frame generation

🫳 Fixed a crash that could occur when grabbing

🧨 Fixed crashes caused by certain gameplay interactions.

🔧 Various additional crash fixes

🔗 View on X
